rules.pickupBusinessTime: all computed pickup dates are normalized into Australia business time: weekdays only, 10:00-16:00; missing/00:00 times become 10:00, after-hours move to the next business slot
rules.expectedPickupTime: if TAD already has plan_pickup_time (palnOutTime), use it as the authoritative pickup time; otherwise use actual_arrived_port_time + 7 days, or plan_arrived_port_time + 7 days when actual arrival is still empty; if that date is already in the past while the order is still undelivered, move it to now + 1 day before normalizing into Australia business time
rules.pickupWarehouseAddress: if TAD already has outWarehouse and the AULALA warehouse master can resolve it, use that warehouse label and address as the real pickup point for display and pricing; otherwise fall back to the default fixed pickup address
rules.clearanceStatus: import_clearance_status now comes from live FBADIDI crowdfund/tad rows when available: 2/clean -> clean, 1/held -> held, empty -> pending
rules.crowdfundScanOrder: production scan is two-phase: first scan /crowdfund/crowdfund/list ordered by actualArrivedPortTime desc and keep only the current inclusive arrival window; then scan /crowdfund/crowdfund/list ordered by planArrivedPortTime desc for rows whose actualArrivedPortTime is still empty but whose planArrivedPortTime lands in that same window; if both arrival fields are empty, skip the crowdfund entirely
rules.eligibility: pull only live crowdfund + TAD rows; a row is eligible only when tad.refName is AULALA and putCode is present; for hall admission use actual_arrived_port_time first, else plan_arrived_port_time, and keep only rows whose chosen arrival date is within the current inclusive arrival window
rules.invoiceData: dropoff address, weight, cbm, provider, refId, and chargeCode are fetched from the external putCode order API first, then the authenticated FBADIDI invoice detail APIs, with the legacy invoice script used only as final fallback
rules.priceFormula: calculate both TLA and Zongheng workbook prices when available, then use the lower one; TLA uses its city zone workbook, Zongheng uses postcode zones plus any interstate truck surcharge based on unload city from destination_port (fallback: crowdfund/warehouse hints); uncovered orders keep max(minimumPriceAud, distanceKm * pallets * audPerKmPerPallet)
rules.autoMergeRule: before entering the hall, unassigned ERP auto orders that share the same physical pickup address are treated as the same warehouse; when they also share the same dropoff address and expected pickup time, merge them into one hall order; if pickupAddress is missing, fall back to the pickup warehouse label
rules.assignmentMergeRule: when a batch-assigned group from the same assignmentSource is already locked to the same driver and shares the same pickup address, dropoff address, and expected pickup time, merge those rows into one delivery order and keep the child putCodes in mergedOrderCodes
rules.orderCodeRule: owner-posted orders use HZ-prefixed codes; non-merged ERP auto orders keep the original putCode; any platform-generated merged order uses a stable ZD-prefixed code derived from the merged child putCodes
